root_cause: endpoints accept a user-supplied file_id and attach it to a caller-controlled resource without verifying the caller owns or was granted the file; once attached its content is reachable via the RAG/file-content paths
impact: read (and overwrite on KB path) another user's private file by knowing/enumerating its UUID
fix_commit_kind: release-merge (OSV git fixed-event; its diff DOES include the fixed routers/folders.py+knowledge.py among 109 files; granular patch commit not separately pinned)
note: Confirmed real (osv+GHSA). Separately, our in-sandbox+ECS dynamic test found a DERIVED-layer leak (D1b) in 0.8.11 NOT covered by this CVE and NOT in any public record -- see studies/apps/open-webui/. Version bisection (ECS) localizes the derived-layer fix to (0.8.11, 0.10.2], consistent with this CVE's 0.9.5.

root_cause: parsed-file delete keyed by integer fileId primary key with no userId/workspaceId ownership scope; finally{} block deletes even when the ownership-checked read fails
impact: a manager/admin in multi-user mode deletes other users' parsed files in any workspace (incl. non-member) by enumerating integer fileId; server returns 'File not found' while deleting
fix_commit_kind: cited by SentinelOne + cve.imfht DBs; NOT independently confirmed on GitHub (allowlist). GHSA-r872-gr59-vf5w is an incomplete-fix follow-up to GHSA-p5rf-8p88-979c
note: integrity/availability (delete) not confidentiality per advisory. Published 2026-06-24.

root_cause: IDOR: any authenticated Dify user can delete another user's chat conversation by conversation id (no ownership/authorization check)
impact: authenticated user deletes another user's chat history (integrity)
fix_commit_kind: UNKNOWN. Prior record's SHA f943f1e39bfb357bb0bf4f04204b9efc5cac85dc is a PURE version-bump commit (5 files: pyproject.toml/uv.lock/compose yaml/package.json, NO security code) -- it is the 1.13.1 release-tag commit, NOT the patch. The real access-control fix is a different commit shipped in 1.13.1, not individually pinned.
note: Authoritative. Dify v1.4.2 later shipped broader 'Tenant Isolation and Credential Security Fixes' (CVE-2025-67732) -- worth following.

root_cause: endpoint checks authentication but not that the caller owns the document or belongs to its knowledge base (IDOR)
impact: authenticated low-privileged user reads documents belonging to other tenants/users (confidentiality)
fixed: none (no fixed version named by NVD/OSV/Tenable; reported via gist+GH issues, no GHSA, likely still unpatched)
note: CWE-284 assigned by CISA ADP (CNA problem-type n/a). Published 2026-10-01. Related: CVE-2026-51894/51896/58579.

root_cause: handler sets authenticated user id then spreads req.body over it; a body-supplied userId overrides the authenticated id and targets another user's keys (mass-assignment / client-asserted identity)
impact: any authenticated user overwrites another user's stored provider API keys; can reroute victim conversations through attacker keys or DoS
fix_commit_kind: UNKNOWN. Prior record's SHA 9eeec6bc4f5e856ac65f50784254d484b2808622 is the v0.8.3-rc1 release/version-bump merge (17 config files, NO /api/keys change) -- NOT the patch. Real fix is a different commit in the release, not individually pinned.
note: EXACT match to our D5 model (client-asserted identity) and course-project harness idor.A->B.28 / MiniRAG client_identity scenario. Repo owner also appears as LibreChat-AI/LibreChat (same project).

root_cause: conversation functions fetch/mutate a conversation by user-supplied id without verifying the requesting user owns it (select(Conversation).where(id==...) with no user filter)
impact: an authenticated/network attacker reads, deletes or renames other users' conversations incl. chat histories
fixed: none (vuln still present at latest release 0.12.0 and main HEAD 9ad3e4e49...; no fix on any branch tip)
fix_commit_kind: none exists (confirmed by cloning: delete_conv still unscoped at HEAD)

root_cause: the first user created in the system can view, modify and delete chats created by an Admin (improper access control across accounts)
impact: a non-admin account accesses/modifies/deletes another (admin) user's chats
fixed: none confirmed (OSV/NVD/SentinelOne name no fixed version; guidance is only 'upgrade later than 0.3.94')
fix_commit_kind: none found (only ref is huntr bounty report, and huntr.com is discontinued)
note: last-affected commit 511f619212d6b9d917494d6ac10f9beca989d4e4. onyx has further access-control CVEs (CVE-2026-42276/42277).

root_cause: getCollectionQuote does not bind its initialId lookup to the caller's authorized chat/collection; a low-privileged user in one tenant reads another tenant's dataset quote/full-text by supplying its data id
impact: cross-tenant read of dataset quote / full text (confidentiality)
fix_commit_kind: GRANULAR fix (via PR #7173; this is the actual patch, not a release bump)
note: endpoint + granular fix commit confirmed via GHSA/PR. Published 2026-07-15. Related: CVE-2026-61684, CVE-2026-54601/54602.

root_cause: shared-conversation handler trusts the attacker-controllable conversation.agent without verifying the user may access that agent (missing agent-access check)
impact: cross-user access via shared conversation agent
fixed: none (fix PR #1328 UNMERGED as of verification; not in master, no tag/release contains it)

root_cause: prompt endpoints accept a prompt id and update it with no owner check (authorization bypass through user-controlled key)
impact: a read-only shared-brain user reads exposed prompt ids and overwrites system prompts affecting all brain users
